idea: Colors (Friday school readiness, long ~2:40 learning song) in the BACKYARD (Ava in HOME outfit): a little RED butterfly flutters down right beside Baby Ava's cheek ('Wow! Look! A red butterfly!'); chorus 'Flutter, flutter, butterflies! Red and yellow, blue and green! … The prettiest colors I have seen!'; one butterfly per verse lands by her – RED (say it with me + flap your arms like wings), YELLOW (yellow like the sun + wiggle your fingers), BLUE (blue like the sky + clap your hands), GREEN (green like the grass + bounce); clap break; review – the four butterflies in a neat row: 'Red, yellow, blue and green! Four butterflies! Which one is blue? Hmm?' (2 s pause) – 'The blue one! Yay!'; final chorus with all four butterflies dancing around her; loop: the hook framing with the red butterfly, 'Bye bye, friends! Bye bye, butterflies!'.

variety.note: last 3 Friday long videos were all Jimmy (body parts, shapes, count to 5) - Ava's first long video; last log star = Jimmy

learning.goal: Name four basic colors - red, yellow, blue, green - and find the blue one when asked
learning.shown_how: one single-color cartoon butterfly per verse beside Ava's face (pure red, lemon yellow, sky blue, grass green); the review shows all four in one neat row; the answer shot has the blue one on her hand
learning.song_repeats: each color sung 4-6 times in its verse + 'Red and yellow, blue and green' in 3 choruses + the review line
learning.interactive_moment: 1:57 'Which one is blue? Hmm?' + pause 1:59.4-2:01.9 (question boing), answer 'The blue one!' 2:02 (cheer + confetti)
learning.copy_me: flap your arms like wings (red), wiggle your fingers (yellow), clap your hands (blue), bounce (green), clap break
learning.fact_check: colors checked in every frame and clip: f1/f4/f5/f12 one red; f6 one yellow; f7 one blue; f8 one green; f9/f10/f11 exactly four (red, yellow, blue, green); color links true (yellow sun, blue sky, green grass)
learning.toddler_fit: one baby, sunny backyard, big face, soft round butterflies with friendly faces, nothing scary

story_order: red from 0:00 (hook); yellow only in the yellow verse 0:37; blue only from 1:09; green only from 1:24; all four together only from the clap break 1:40 on (after green). Chorus 1-2 shots show only Ava or the red butterfly.
